'''Linna''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who piloted an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] under [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken's]] [[Ace Squadron (New Republic)|Ace Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]].<ref name="Bacta" />

One of her [[J-77 "Event Horizon" sublight engine/Legends|engines]] had a problem and they made a stopover at the [[Empress-class space station]] for repairs.<ref name="Bacta" />
